newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Korsar airline passenger, cargo up in '96.
newsitem.headline: Russian Korsar airline passenger, cargo up in '96.

text.p: Russian private airline AO Korsar carried 51,000 passengers and 430 tonnes of cargo in 1996 after 43,000 passengers and 332 tonnes of cargo in 1995, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
But Larisa Kiryushkina said the company had met serious difficulties last year.
"Russian airport tarrifs, including fuel rates, increased 20 percent over the year, causing trouble for small carriers," she said, adding that passenger air traffic to Russian provinces had declined.
"We were forced to close regular passenger service between Moscow and Kirovsk in the Urals. People in the Urals did not receive salaries for months and could not pay for tickets," she said.
Korsar operates 18 passenger and cargo aircraft. It leases most of its planes but owns two Tupolev-154s.
The company makes regular passenger flights between Moscow and Paphos, Cyprus and between Moscow and Nizhnevartovsk, Siberia. It also operates domestic and international charters.
